name: Ethiopian Citizenship by Marriage

requirements.blocker_text: Married to an Ethiopian national, in a marriage valid under Ethiopian or applicable foreign law.
At least 2 years since the marriage, plus at least 1 year of residence in Ethiopia before applying.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married 2 years and reside in Ethiopia for 1 year before applying.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 1 year's residence in Ethiopia
Proof of release from prior nationality

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: at least 1 year of residence in Ethiopia before applying

sources.title: African Child Policy Forum (hosting the full text) -- Ethiopian Nationality Proclamation No. 378/2003: foreign spouse of an Ethiopian national may naturalise where the marriage is valid, at least 2 years have passed since the marriage, and the applicant has resided in Ethiopia for 1 year before applying

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ethiopia). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2 sourcing caveat as et_citizenship_naturalisation.json. Gender-neutral: no gendered language distinguishing a foreign wife from a foreign husband was found in the sourced text -- unlike the sharp gendered asymmetries found in Qatar's and Bahrain's marriage-citizenship provisions built elsewhere in this dataset, Ethiopia's current marriage route appears to apply equally regardless of which spouse is Ethiopian. Notably faster than the standard 4-year naturalisation track (2 years married + 1 year residence, which can run partly concurrently, versus 4 years domicile outright).
